title: Crash when GDScript scripts are reloaded during initial import
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.5.beta [e0603aeda3ce0e15c5843f5202172a56f3ff5534]
- Not reproducible in: 4.4.1.stable [custom]

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta (custom) - macOS Sequoia (15.5.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Mobile) - integrated Apple M2 Pro (Apple8) - Apple M2 Pro (10 threads) - 32.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

After upgrading from 4.4.1-stable to 4.5-beta3, we have started seeing crashes during a fresh import (mainly in the context of `--headless --import`) which manifest in a few different ways, but always starts from the `GDScriptLanguage::reload_all_scripts` call that happens in `GDExtensionManager::_reload_all_scripts`, like so:

```
GDScriptFunction::call(GDScriptInstance*, Variant const**, int, Callable::CallError&, GDScriptFunction::CallState*) (modules/gdscript/gdscript_vm.cpp:500)
GDScript::_create_instance(Variant const**, int, Object*, bool, Callable::CallError&) (modules/gdscript/gdscript.cpp:192)
GDScript::_new(Variant const**, int, Callable::CallError&) (modules/gdscript/gdscript.cpp:238)
MethodBindVarArgTR<GDScript, Variant>::call(Object*, Variant const**, int, Callable::CallError&) const (core/object/method_bind.h:265)
GDScriptFunction::call(GDScriptInstance*, Variant const**, int, Callable::CallError&, GDScriptFunction::CallState*) (modules/gdscript/gdscript_vm.cpp:2051)
GDScript::_static_init() (modules/gdscript/gdscript.cpp:678)
GDScript::reload(bool) (modules/gdscript/gdscript.cpp:886)
GDScriptLanguage::reload_scripts(Array const&, bool) (modules/gdscript/gdscript.cpp:2659)
GDScriptLanguage::reload_all_scripts() (modules/gdscript/gdscript.cpp:2564)
GDExtensionManager::_reload_all_scripts() (core/extension/gdextension_manager.cpp:298)
Callable::callp(Variant const**, int, Variant&, Callable::CallError&) const (core/variant/callable.cpp:57)
CallQueue::_call_function(Callable const&, Variant const*, int, bool) (core/object/message_queue.cpp:220)
CallQueue::flush() (core/object/message_queue.cpp:268)
SceneTree::physics_process(double) (scene/main/scene_tree.cpp:636)
Main::iteration() (main/main.cpp:4716)
OS_MacOS_Headless::run() (platform/macos/os_macos.mm:1206)
main (platform/macos/godot_main_macos.mm:126)
```

As best I can tell, the `GDFunction` being called here seems to be pointing to at least a partially stale (or otherwise incorrect) memory address.

As seen earlier in the backtrace, it's trying to invoke the initializer of the class in question:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e0603aeda3ce0e15c5843f5202172a56f3ff5534/modules/gdscript/gdscript.cpp#L190-L192

However, this particular class doesn't have an initializer, so instead `_super_constructor` provides the base class initializer, which does exist. This then (as seen in the code above) gets assigned to become the derived class initializer, which is what somehow becomes stale during the reloading of the scripts.

I've been able to fix this crash by simply not having `initializer` be overwritten there, and instead just have it be a local variable.

### Steps to reproduce

N/A

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Unfortunately my attempts at reducing this down to an MRP have been unsuccessful.
